description: The N issuers with the largest currently FCA-disclosed net short positions market-wide, sorted descending by aggregated position %. Reads the same daily "aggregated-current-net-short-positions" file as fca_short_positions -- aggregated per issuer, no holder names. Example: fca_largest_shorts({ top_n: 10 }).

top_n.description: How many issuers to return, most-shorted first. Default 20, max 100.

name: fca_largest_shorts
title: Fca Largest Shorts
